//: The CRON tier (CRON_MODE=only, :4001). Identical to nodemon.json except for the sentinel: this one watches dev-restart.cron.json, so an HTTP route or WebSocket change no longer restarts the scheduler mid-job. src is deliberately NOT watched — src/utils/dev/hot-reload.ts swaps what it can in place and touches THIS role's sentinel when it cannot, deciding with src/utils/dev/restart-scope.ts whether the change is even ours. The sentinel must exist before nodemon starts (it resolves its watch list once and silently drops missing entries): backend/scripts/ensure-dev-sentinel.mjs creates all three from predev.
